Lead AI engineer

Utrecht, Utrecht, Netherlands 
About the job
About Ynteq

We are Ynteq, a fast-growing start-up that builds an AI maintenance platform (CMMS) for the manufacturing industry. We are on a mission to make the industry smarter, cleaner and more efficient. Our platform has three unique selling points: simple-to-use, smart, and AI-native by design. Maintenance software today documents work after the fact. Ynteq focuses on making maintenance work better as it happens by removing friction, automating the obvious, and supporting better decisions.



The role

As a Lead AI Engineer, you will design, build, and own the AI capabilities at the core of Ynteq’s CMMS platform. Your work will directly support technicians, planners, and reliability managers in planning, executing, and improving maintenance work.

This is a hands-on, senior role for someone who has shipped AI into production and understands how to turn models into trusted, everyday tools.



What you’ll work on

You will build and ship AI-powered features such as:



Smart work order creation from text, voice, and operational signals
Automatic classification of failures, causes, and actions
AI-assisted task breakdowns, checklists, and spare part suggestions
Maintenance prioritization and planning support
Pattern detection across historical maintenance and asset data
Workflow-native copilots embedded directly in daily maintenance flows
You’ll work end-to-end: from problem framing to production, evaluation, and iteration.


What we’re looking for

You are a senior engineer with strong technical depth and product judgment. You have:



5+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant AI exposure
Proven experience shipping AI-powered features into production
Hands-on experience with LLMs and applied AI systems
Strong backend engineering skills (APIs, services, data pipelines)
Experience working with messy, real-world operational data
The ability to make pragmatic trade-offs between automation and control
A product mindset: you care about usability, trust, and outcomes


Our working principles



Build for real users in real operations
Prefer simple systems that work reliably
Treat AI as a copilot, not a black box
Ship early, learn from usage, iterate fast
Take ownership from idea to impact
Say no to AI when it doesn’t add value


Why Ynteq



Greenfield CMMS platform with AI at its core
Real industrial problems with measurable impact
High ownership and autonomy
Competitive salary, equity, and benefits
A team that values clarity and concrete results and short time to market
Backed by an entrepreneurial team with proven success in the same industry...
... and become one of the first employees of a unicorn


Please apply on Linkedin or via our website
